hero.title: About Investment Diary
hero.subtitle: A professional investment diary management system

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: Investment Diary is dedicated to providing investors with a simple yet powerful tool to record investment decisions, track trading performance, and learn from historical data. We believe that systematic investment record-keeping is key to long-term investment success.

story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: Investment Diary was born from the need for a simple investment tool. The founder found that the market lacked a diary system truly designed for individual investors that could combine transaction records, reminders, and reflection features.
story.paragraph2: After careful design and development, Investment Diary has now become a complete investment management platform, supporting various features including FIFO cost calculation, timeline view, smart alerts, and more.
story.paragraph3: We continuously improve our product, dedicated to providing investors with the best experience. Thank you for choosing Investment Diary as your investment partner.

diary.title: Markdown Diary
diary.description: Support Markdown syntax for writing diaries, allowing you to format text, insert code, and create rich investment records.

fifo.title: FIFO Cost Calculation
fifo.description: Automatically calculate stock costs using the First-In-First-Out method, accurately tracking profit and loss for each transaction.

realtime.title: Real-time Alert System
realtime.description: Set time-triggered alerts, and the system will notify you at the specified time, ensuring you never miss important moments.

privacy.title: Data Privacy Protection
privacy.description: All data is securely stored with HTTPS encrypted transmission, passwords are bcrypt encrypted, ensuring your privacy and security.

contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.description: Have questions or suggestions? Feel free to contact us via GitHub, or start using Investment Diary directly.
